import numpy as np
# Verify quadrant layout and create transform
assert np.array_equal(Q[0],A)
assert np.array_equal(Q[1],np.rot90(A,3))
assert np.array_equal(Q[2],np.rot90(A,1))
assert np.array_equal(Q[3],np.rot90(A,2))
def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid, dtype=int)
    upper=np.concatenate([a,np.rot90(a,3)],axis=1)
    lower=np.concatenate([np.rot90(a,1),np.rot90(a,2)],axis=1)
    return np.concatenate([upper,lower],axis=0).tolist()
assert transform(inp1)==out1
test=[[5]*11 for _ in range(11)]
testout=transform(test)
print(len(testout),len(testout[0]),set(sum(testout,[])))
program='''import numpy as np\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    a = np.array(grid, dtype=int)\n    upper = np.concatenate([a, np.rot90(a, 3)], axis=1)\n    lower = np.concatenate([np.rot90(a, 1), np.rot90(a, 2)], axis=1)\n    return np.concatenate([upper, lower], axis=0).tolist()\n'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(program)
print('saved',p)
